description: Fork of exp729 (E=384, NAP-bump, FastMultiHeadLUT). Swaps forward_mode from 'hard' to 'hybrid_smooth' — top-2 forward (main + alt at least-confident anchor, sigmoid-blended) with the same NAP+1 Hamming-1 ball backward. Fills the missing matrix slot vs exp724 (hybrid_smooth + K-row dense bwd: soft 1.1936, hard 1.2611, gap +0.068), exp726 (NAP+1 fwd + autograd bwd: soft 1.1997, hard 1.3399, gap +0.140), exp729 (hard + ball bwd: hard 1.2360). Hypothesis: ball backward's NAP+1 rows include the alt row that top-2 forward uses, so gradient signal lines up with forward selection -> smaller hard-soft gap than exp724. Bench (out_proj NAP=7, B=12288): FastMHL hybrid_smooth/ball = 24.0 ms (after Jun-6 dispatch optimisation), vs hard/ball = 21.2 ms. Per-step LUT-call wall-clock ~760 ms (vs ~420 ms for exp729 hard mode) -> estimated 7-8 h. Both soft (hybrid_smooth eval) and hard (FastMHL forward_mode flipped to 'hard' at val time) bpb are logged at every eval_every=200 steps.
